notes.text: m0: supply likely loose (cloud price cut news, spot/idx=1.05x)

m1: supply loose (CoWoS news, spot .054M = 0.63x idx). Gen N launch narrowed to m12-13 (m0 rumor 14, m1 rumor 11). Broker A 1k pending m1. Inf m0=6.39 (growth TBD). Power 24MW energises m8 so m1-7 powered H capped at 11.43k, fixed m1-7 cap 109 kH-m covers W0. Plan: set_spot 0, await Broker A result and inf growth signal before ordering more H/power.

m2: supply likely tight (spot .183M = 1.96x idx, CoWoS booked news). Gen N launch est m12-13. Broker A delivered 1k (~72% reliable). Inf m0=6.39 m1=6.36 (3% vs 7% still uncertain). Note queue #2 (placed m0) shipped 0k in m1 so orders start shipping 2m after order. Plan: buy 5k H vendor (28k total to match 40MW at m8), keep spot 0.

m3: supply tight (spot .51M = 2.68x idx, idx +3.7%, m2 H shipped 1.47k). Gen N launch est m12 (rumors 14,11,12 -> 12-13). Export-control draft rumor (50% risk m5-15). Broker A ~72% reliable. Inf m0=6.39 m1=6.36 m2=6.41 (~70% 3% growth). W0 30.7/60 on track with fixed cap. Plan: wait with 28k H in pipeline matching 40MW at m8, keep spot 0.

m4: supply tight (spot .223M = 1.97x idx, CoWoS booked news, m3 H shipped 2.02k). Gen N launch est m12-13. Broker A ~72% reliable. Inf m0..3 = 6.39, 6.36, 6.41, 6.49 -> strongly 3% growth. W0 40.64/60 on track with fixed cap. Plan: hold 28k H pipeline, wait until m6-7 for W2 power and any export-control/inf updates.

m5: supply likely flipped loose (CoWoS online news, spot .58M = 1.48x idx, m4 shipped 1.71k tight). Gen N launch est m12-13. No export controls yet. Broker A ~72% reliable. Inf m0..4 = 6.39, 6.36, 6.41, 6.49, 6.89 -> 3% growth. W0 50.18/60 will finish m6-7. Plan: let 7.8k H queue ship before m8, plan ~24MW W2 power around m7.

m6: supply tight (m5 shipped 1.41k, idx +3.8%, rival spot .418M = 2.44x idx). Gen N launch est m12 (rumors 14,11,12,11 -> 12-13). Inf m0..5 = 6.39..7.68 (still ~85% 3% growth with m5 +noise). W0 56.93/60 will finish m6. Plan: sign 24MW power now so 64MW ready by m14 for Gen N (will add final ~16-20MW around m12 to replace expiring 16MW at m20).

m7: supply tight (idx +9.9%, m6 shipped 2.23k, spot .724M = 1.37x idx). Gen N launch est m12-13. Inf m0..6 = 6.39..7.50 -> 3% baseline confirmed (watch for m8-15 switch). W0 done 63.86/60. Power 24MW turns on m8 (40MW total) and another 24MW turns on m11 (64MW total). Plan: enter W1 with 28k H pipeline + 3k cloud, save cash for Gen N launch.

m8: W0 met (71.37/60). All 28k H delivered and powered (40MW active). Supply uncertain (hyperscaler demand news vs spot .004M = 1.17x idx, m7 shipped 4.16k loose). Gen N launch still est m12-13. Inf m7=6.92 (3% continues, watch m8-15 for switch). Plan: 28k H + 3k cloud covers W1

m9: supply likely flipped loose (CoWoS online news, spot .012M = 1.14x idx after m8 idx +3.7%). Gen N launch est m12-13 (rumors 14,11,12,11,11,13). Inf m8=8.48 (watch for m8 switch to 7% vs noise on 3%). W1 22.52/140 well ahead. Plan: hold cash (15.5M) for Gen N launch and final power block at m11-12.

m10: supply flipped tight (CoWoS booked news, spot .891M = 2.25x idx after m9 loose idx -2.5%). Gen N launch est m12-13. Inf m8=8.48 m9=8.51 (ambiguous 3% vs switch to 7% at m8). W1 45.01/140 on track. Plan: hold cash (44.7M) for Gen N launch and final power block at m11-12.

m11: supply tight (CoWoS booked news, idx +0.9%, spot .464M = 1.41x idx). Gen N not confirmed in m11 so likely launches m13 (or 20% unconfirmed m12). Inf m8..10 = 8.48, 8.51, 8.75 (watch for 7% switch). 64MW now active, W1 67.26/140 on track. Plan: sign 20MW power now so 68MW guaranteed by m20 after 16MW expires, keep cash 73.9M ready for Gen N.

m12: supply tight (Distributors longer lead times news, idx +4.9%, spot .657M = 2.00x idx). Vendor confirmed Gen N launches m13. Inf m8..11 = 8.48, 8.51, 8.75, 8.59 -> still 3% growth. W1 89.67/140 on track. Plan: save 99.5M cash for m13 Gen N orders (vendor + Broker A) and post-drop cloud reserves.

m13: Gen N launched! Supply tight (post-drop idx .517 = +10.6% adj, spot .95M = 1.94x idx). Inf m12=8.61 (3% continues, watch m13-15 for switch). W1 112.06/140 finishes m14. Power 64MW active (84MW at m18, 68MW at m20). Plan: order 6k N vendor (40M) and 4k N Broker A (76M) using cash (25.1M) without debt, await m14-15 signals.

m14: supply tight (HBM yields news, idx +8.7%, spot .723M = 2.26x idx). Inf m13=8.98 (3% growth continues, watch m14-15). W1 131.08/140 finishes this month. Broker A 4k N confirms end of m14. Plan: hold until m15 to see Broker A result and cloud prices for m16-21.

m15: supply tight (hyperscaler+rival news, idx +6.5%, spot .148M). Inf m14=9.84 (possible switch to 7% around m13 vs noise). W1 149.24/140 met. 4k N from Broker A delivered (now 7k delivered capacity 36kH). Plan: order 3k N Broker A (32M, usable m17) and reserve 3kH 6m cloud (m16-21 at .02M) to hit ~426 kH-m base for W2, adjust in m16 after seeing #5 shipment and m15 inf.

m16: W1 met (174.41/140). Inf m12..15 = 8.61, 8.98, 9.84, 10.83 -> switched to 7% around m13 (W2 needs ~435.8 kH-m). Supply tight (m15 N shipped 1.43k, idx +4.8%, spot .024M = 2.18x idx). Broker A 3k N confirms end of m16. Plan: reserve 3kH 6m cloud (m17-22 at .118M) instead of expensive late vendor N under 2% debt interest, await Broker A #7 result at m17.

m17: supply may have flipped loose (idx -2.8%, spot .475M = 1.38x idx, m16 N shipped 1.34k tight). Broker A #7 3k N delivered (3/3 -> reliable). Inf m16=11.60 confirms 7% trend (~107.4 kH-m needed m17-23, total 397.2 kH-m left). Existing cap gives 400.6 kH-m (+3.5 buffer). Plan: reserve 2kH 6m cloud (m18-23 at .060M) for +15.5 kH-m safety margin while clearing debt at m18.

m18: supply loose (m17 N shipped 3.16k, idx -15.9%, spot .726M = 1.15x idx despite rival buying). Inf m17=12.26 confirms 7% trend. Debt nearly cleared (+.6M cash). W2 71.53/320 with 362.8 kH-m capacity vs ~342.3 needed m18-23 (+20.5 buffer). Plan: hold existing fleet and cloud contracts through m18-21, reassess surplus around m21-22.

m19: supply flipped tight (spot .006M = 3.03x idx after m18 loose idx -12.3%). Inf m18=12.21 (7% trend with -noise). W2 121.17/320 on track with 301 kH-m locked capacity vs ~276.6 needed m19-23 (+24.4 buffer). 68MW covers all 60MW fleet in m20-23. Plan: hold fleet and cloud contracts through completion.

m20: supply likely flipped loose (HBM loosening news after m19 tight idx +9.3%). Inf m19=15.77 (high +noise on 7% trend). W2 167.4/320 with 239 kH-m locked cap m20-23 vs ~218-228 needed. 68MW active powers full 60MW fleet. Plan: hold fleet and cloud contracts, monitor m20-22 inference.

m21: supply likely loose (idx -1.5%) though spot .551M = 2.50x idx high. Inf m20=14.14 (7% trend). W2 215.26/320 with 177 kH-m capacity m21-23 vs ~155.5 needed (+21.5 buffer). Plan: hold through m21-22, check exact surplus at m23 for potential resell of unused H/N to save 2% depreciation.

m22: supply loose (cloud price cut news, idx -9.8%, spot .977M = 1.54x idx). Inf m21=16.09 (7% trend). W2 261.17/320 with 115 kH-m capacity m22-23 vs ~94.1 needed (+20.9 buffer). Plan: run m22 at full 59 kH then resell excess H/N up to 3k/gen at m23 once remaining training need is tiny.

m23: supply flipped tight (longer lead times news, spot .436M = 1.99x idx after m22 loose idx -4.8%). Inf m22=17.80 (7% trend). W2 302.37/320 leaves only 17.63 training + ~19.05 inf = ~36.7 needed in m23 out of 56 kH cap. Plan: resell max 3k H and 3k N in m23 (leaving 47 kH = +10.3 kH margin) to capture m23 resale value and save 2% m24 depreciation.
